summary: Clearwater NF lookout 14 miles NE of Kooskia, Idaho: 100-ft steel Aermotor tower from about 1936, abandoned 1967, tower removed 1978; no description of the site today.

notes_for_editor: Coordinates disagree: our record (46.23479, -115.706) and a second set (46.22622, -115.71867) are about 1.4 km apart. The story gives no coordinates. Idaho Fire Lookouts gives elevation 4517 ft and the Forest Service list agrees; the story uses that figure. The Forest Service list has a typo ('Aerometer') so it is not quoted. The sources found no photo URLs we could use (firelookout.com and the Forest Service list credit photos without links). No source describes current access or what remains at the site; Idaho Fire Lookouts tags the site 'Drive-Up' but records the tower as removed.
